title: The Man
author: Bram Stoker
description: "The Man" by Bram Stoker is a novel published in 1905.
longDescription: This Gothic tale follows Stephen Norman, a young woman raised as a tomboy by her father after her mother's death. When Stephen boldly proposes marriage to the wrong man, she faces humiliation and loses her childhood friend Harold.

authorInfo.bio: Abraham Stoker was an Irish writer, barrister, literary critic, and theatre manager. He was the author of the Gothic horror novel Dracula (1897) and the creator of the fictional character Count Dracula. The work and its antagonist are regarded as milestones in the fields of Gothic and vampire literature.
